title: Atik Mustafa Pasha Mosque

buildingCutout.basis: Named current four-sided footprint covering the standing mosque and its porch.

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain immediately west of the raised timber entrance.

mapIdentity.provider: Named current footprint aligned with the historical survey and current heritage inventory.
mapIdentity.scope: The named current outline measures 18.80 m by 15.54 m. The architectural inventory records a 17.5 m by 15 m original church body, three polygonal apses and a tower at the southwest corner.

note: Van Millingen describes triple arcade bays, an upper tripartite light and three externally faceted apses. Eyice and Istanbul’s religious-affairs inventory record the timber porch and later single-balcony stone minaret with a stone cap. Qualla’s exact 2025 interior photograph shows the uninterrupted dome bowl and taller side windows of the restored building.
